text:
mira: starting a quick thread — ran quant profiles for skyline-13b across H100/A100 in us-west / eu-west, microbatch sweep 1/2/4/8. posting raw p50/p95 and quality deltas.

sam: awesome — what's the baseline and the eval?

mira: baseline = FP16 on H100, microbatch=1. eval = zero-shot MMLU subset + TriviaQA sample (1k prompts). reporting throughput (tok/s), p50/p95 latency (ms), and MMLU acc delta.

lee: curious about calibration details for int8 — per-channel or per-tensor?

mira: int8 = per-channel scale + 512 calibration samples from in-domain. fp8 uses dynamic shared exponent, no extra calibration.

juan: any kernel changes between regions? we saw fused-attn vs tiled-attn differences before.

mira: yes — EU cluster falls back to tiled-attn kernel on A100 driver 510.x; US uses fused-attn on optimized runtime. had to force `ATTN_KERNEL=autotune` to compare apples->apples.

perf-bot: summary job 2387654321 finished — artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/skyline/2387654321/{h100,a100}/{us,eu}/report.html

mira: quick numbers (microbatch=1):
- H100 FP16 (baseline): throughput 920 tok/s, p50 86ms, p95 210ms, MMLU acc 64.2
- H100 INT8: throughput 1320 tok/s (+43%), p50 62ms, p95 150ms, MMLU acc 63.1 (-1.1)
- H100 FP8: throughput 1480 tok/s (+61%), p50 55ms, p95 135ms, MMLU acc 63.6 (-0.6)
- A100 FP16: throughput 740 tok/s, p50 110ms, p95 290ms, MMLU acc 64.2
- A100 INT8 (tiled kernel): throughput 980 tok/s (+32 vs a100 fp16), p50 85ms, p95 210ms, MMLU acc 62.3 (-1.9)

sam: notable that fp8 gives bigger speedup on H100 than A100 — kernel support + memory layout probably. did you run microbatch=4?

mira: yes, microbatch=4 aggregated: H100 FP16 1680 tok/s, INT8 2300 (+37%), FP8 2600 (+55%). p95 improved but not linearly; small batch latency penalty hides under higher throughput.

lee: what about quality regressions by prompt bucket? any catastrophic tails?

mira: split by difficulty bins: easy/no-context little change, medium ~0.8–1.2% drop for int8, hard prompts saw up to 2.7% drop for int8 but fp8 stayed within 1.5%. flagged top 200 failure cases in the artifact.

juan: capacity sizing implication? if customer needs 95th latency < 250ms for microbatch=1, which config wins in eu?

mira: EU A100 with INT8 (tiled) p95 ~210ms meets target and gives ~32% cost win vs FP16. but fallback to tiled kernel increases variance — recommend Dedicated H100 if consistent p95 needed at scale.

sam: any kernel-level knobs? e.g., `KV_CACHE_COMPACT=1` or fused qkv layout?

mira: tested `KV_CACHE_COMPACT=1` reduced p95 by ~8% on H100 INT8. Enabling `FUSED_QKV=1` on A100 caused correctness issues in driver 510.39 — disabled in EU runs.

perf-bot: regression alert: INT8 MMLU delta -1.9% exceeds threshold 1.5% for model skyline-13b on A100-eu (job 2387654321). Created ticket #PERF-4123.

mira: next steps: 1) rerun A100-eu with newer driver + fused kernel flag, 2) run per-layer sensitivity to see where int8 fails, 3) generate micro-calibration set from prod prompts for customers who hit regressions.

sam: thanks — can you upload a short table summary (csv) with per-region rows and microbatch columns? I'll throw into the ops deck.

mira: yup — uploading CSV now: s3://redwood-perf/skyline/2387654321/summary.csv :thumbsup:

lee: pinging infra to schedule H100 dedicated slots for a longer run next week — @infra-ops

mira: noted. I'll add experimental flags used and calibration scripts to the artifact.

juan: great thread — this is actionable for rollout decisions.

mira: thanks all — closing after re-run and ticket triage.
